summary: Model card for Gemini 3.5 Audio (Live Translate, Transcribe, Transcribe Live), audio models based on Gemini 3 Pro. It reports no benchmark numbers (links to external methodology), lists voice/translation limitations, names safety evaluation types without results, and relies on Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.7 Flash for frontier safety.
